alt_text: An animated presentation drawn live in code, with no people in it. A plain white slide titled Your website lists: on someone else's server, on someone else's template, on someone else's terms. A cursor types Whose is it?, and a selection box picks it out. The slide tears in two to show 'A site you own' over glowing clouds at dusk: the files, the history and the address are yours. A split screen sets Rented, identical grey template cards on a belt, beside Owned, a valley at sunset with lights coming on. Thousands of lit boxes appear under the words No server code, no cookies, no tracking. Snapshots of the earlier slides lie along a rising curve, with a box marking You are here, and the line The history is yours. Points of light gather into a ring: Move it anywhere, at any time, sovereignwebsite.org. A final card: built by AI agents working under a written Agent Behaviour Policy.
